logline: When Rupert frantically orders Alexander's arrest, the royal guards refuse and salute the true Duke, before damning Crown intelligence documents expose Rupert and Lord Sterling's treasonous plot.
continuity_notes: Follows directly from Episode 42; inside the ruined cathedral, Alexander confronts Rupert before the congregation, armed with evidence from the Crown to reclaim his rightful title.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up on Rupert Ashburn standing before the altar, trembling with mounting panic and rage.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Hysterical, Panicked)
events.content: "You're lying!"

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Rupert lunges forward, his facial features contorting in venomous desperation.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tracking shot swinging around Rupert as he turns toward the royal guards stationed along the aisle, pointing furiously down the center of the hall.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Shrieking, Frantic)
events.content: "This man is an imposter! Arrest him!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide symmetrical shot framing Alexander Ashburn standing immovable in the center of the cathedral, flanking lines of red-coated guards on both sides.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander stands completely composed in his dark embroidered aristocratic coat, staring Rupert down with unyielding authority.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up on Rupert's furious face, veins bulging at his temples.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Enraged, Screaming)
events.content: "I said arrest him!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot on the Royal Guard Captain in ceremonial bearskin uniform standing steadfast.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The Guard Captain brings his ceremonial sword upright to attention, his expression stern and resolute.

events.label: ROYAL GUARD (Firm, Defiant)
events.content: "We will not."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle shot looking down along the polished stone floor as the guard's sword tip grounds firmly between Rupert and the guards.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Outraged, Stunned)
events.content: "I am Lord Rupert Ashburn!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up on Rupert thumping his chest in indignant disbelief.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate)
events.content: "Your Duke!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot framing the Guard Captain and Alexander in profile.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The Guard Captain snaps a crisp salute toward Alexander.

events.label: ROYAL GUARD (Calm, Resolute)
events.content: "No. He is your Duke."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot on Catherine in her bridal gown and Lord Henry Sterling seated in the front pew, both frozen in stunned shock.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Lord Sterling clutches his gold-headed walking cane tightly, his jaw clenching as tension spreads through the church.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot on Rupert spinning toward the gathered congregation, his hands flailing.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate, Flustered)
events.content: "You have all been deceived!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up on Alexander, commanding and icy.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Authoritative)
events.content: "Then let the Crown decide."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Alexander's hands holding an official War Office document bundle sealed with red wax and ribbon.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander brings forth the dossier stamped "WAR OFFICE - TOP SECRET" with the royal crest.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Alexander holding up the sealed parcel before the room.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Grave, Powerful)
events.content: "These were delivered to me under the seal of the Crown."

events.label: ALEXANDER (Commanding)
events.content: "Read the first."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Lord Sterling looking sideways, his face pale with rising dread.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Two-shot of Alexander handing the dossier to a Crown Military Magistrate wearing white gloves and a high-collared black uniform.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The Crown Official receives the dossier solemnly with both hands.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up on the Crown Official opening the binder and reading aloud.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Crisp sound of parchment turning.

events.label: CROWN OFFICIAL (Clear, Formal)
events.content: "Military Intelligence Report, Iberian front, three years ago."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Rupert staring wide-eyed, completely petrified.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up on the Crown Official continuing the official reading.

events.label: CROWN OFFICIAL (Solemn, Objective)
events.content: "Duke Alexander Ashburn's unit was ambushed after his location was compromised."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Frontal medium shot of the Crown Official turning a page as the congregation listens in breathless silence.

events.label: CROWN OFFICIAL (Accusing, Measured)
events.content: "The report identifies the leak as deliberate."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot across the rubble of the cathedral floor showing Rupert crumbling in fear against the choir railing.

events.label: CROWN OFFICIAL (Voice Continuing)
events.content: "Information regarding the Duke's position was transmitted through British channels."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Rupert staggers backward, his knees buckling as he leans his weight heavily on the stone balustrade.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Rupert clinging to the stone pillar, his breath shallow and terrified.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot on Alexander stepping forward, thrusting the secondary dossier forward.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Implacable)
events.content: "Read the names."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up on the Crown Official reading the concluding section.

events.label: CROWN OFFICIAL (Deliberate, Damning)
events.content: "Lord Henry Sterling."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Quick pan to Lord Sterling stiffening in his pew, then the Crown Official.

events.label: CROWN OFFICIAL (Continuing)
events.content: "Rupert Ashburn."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up on Rupert's horrified eyes darting in sheer terror.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on the Dowager Duchess covering her mouth in agonizing disbelief.

events.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Shaken, Devastated)
events.content: "My God..."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle shot on Alexander towering over the fallen Rupert.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Furious, Thunderous)
events.content: "You sold my men to the enemy."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Rupert waving his hands defensively, hyperventilating.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate, Denying)
events.content: "I didn't!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle tracking push-in on Alexander raising the red-ribboned war document toward the cathedral arches.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Resonant, Accusatory)
events.content: "And when you believed I was dead..."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Quick reaction shot on Rupert gasping on the steps.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up on Alexander's scarred, furious face.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Venomous)
events.content: "You took my title."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up on the Crown Official's gloved thumb cracking the red wax seal open.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Brittle snap of breaking sealing wax.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Full shot of the Crown Official standing amidst church debris reading the death register.

events.label: CROWN OFFICIAL (Grave, Official)
events.content: "Official death confirmation was filed three months after the ambush."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Two-shot of the Crown Official in the background and Alexander's dark silhouette in the foreground.

events.label: CROWN OFFICIAL (Continuing)
events.content: "Duke Alexander Ashburn was declared dead."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide majestic shot capturing the entire nave, the rows of horrified guests, and the ruined cathedral windows.

events.label: CROWN OFFICIAL (Loud, Authoritative)
events.content: "His estate and title were subsequently transferred under false authority."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up on Rupert clutching his chest as if choking on his own lies.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Screaming, Desperate)
events.content: "I was told he was dead!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low shot following Alexander's heavy boots stepping steadily up the stone steps toward the altar.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Penetrating)
events.content: "You were told exactly what you needed to hear."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot on Rupert whirling around in a frenzy, pointing his finger toward Lord Sterling.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Frantic, Betraying)
events.content: "Sterling handled the report!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Alexander turns his head sharply toward the side pews.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Lord Henry Sterling silently slipping out of his seat and making a break toward the side exit.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Catherine peering out from under her bridal veil in shock.

events.label: CATHERINE (Shocked, Murmuring)
events.content: "My Lord?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Lord Sterling frantically unlatching the heavy oak church door and pulling it open.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Heavy iron latch clicking open and wooden door creaking.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Reverse angle from inside the doorway showing a stern British Police Constable standing directly outside, blocking the passage.

events.label: POLICE CONSTABLE (Firm, Sardonic)
events.content: "Going somewhere, Lord Sterling?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up on Lord Sterling's face frozen in pure terror, his jaw agape as his escape is completely cut off, holding until fade to black.

analysis_metadata.note: No invented LLM scene metadata; event-level evidence drives promo selection.
